A seleção é voltada a pessoas com Parkin: The selection is intended for people with Parkinson’s, older adults and caregivers. We first research specialist Parkinson’s organizations, then sources covering general health, ageing, independence, exercise, prevention, access to care and caregiver support.
Priorizamos publicações das últimas 24 h: We prioritize publications from the last 24 hours and accept articles no more than 7 days after original publication. An update, event date or older study date does not replace the article’s original publication date.
Aceitamos assuntos de alcance nacional o: We accept subjects with national or global scope. We exclude services, events, campaigns, openings and schedules limited to a city, state or region, as well as fundraising and courses. A study carried out in one city may qualify when its findings have broader application.
Pesquisamos em português, inglês, francê: We search in Portuguese, English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Dutch and Japanese, seeking variety across countries. Every country or source is not guaranteed to appear in each edition.
Abrimos a página da fonte para verificar: We open source pages to verify the text and original date. We reject future, conflicting or unverifiable dates, pages outside permitted sources and links without discovery evidence. Listing a source does not mean all of its content will be selected.
A avaliação de alcance deve estar apoiad: Scope assessment must be supported by a literal passage from the article itself. We remove duplicate links and topics within an edition and avoid repeating those published in the previous 7 days.
A coleta automática está programada para: Automatic collection is scheduled for 6 a.m. São Paulo time. The testing period runs from 28 October 2026 until before midnight at the start of 4 November 2026. After this period, automatic updates pause and the last verified edition remains available. A scheduled collection does not guarantee a new edition if it fails.
Abra Notícias de Saúde, confira a data d: Open Health News, check the edition and article dates, and follow the link to read the original source. Check whether the summary matches the source and report any discrepancy in date, translation, topic or scope to the Lumi team. Opening this help does not start a new search.
Cada nova edição reúne de 6 a 10 matéria: Each new edition contains 6 to 10 complete readings, with at most two per organization and an internal editorial score of at least 7 out of 10. This score expresses editorial relevance and credibility; it is not a measure of scientific certainty. Ordering prioritizes Parkinson’s stories from specialist sources, then score and recency.
Apresentamos título e resumo substancial: We present a title and substantial summary in Brazilian Portuguese, with 80 to 180 words in three paragraphs: what happened, why it matters and the limitations of the evidence. Each reading includes its source, publication date and original link. Summaries should distinguish animal research, clinical trials and approved treatments. News is not individual medical advice.
A coleta distribui candidatos entre orga: Collection distributes candidates across organizations and performs a supplementary search when there are too few articles or too little source variety. When fewer than 6 readings are new, we place new items first and fill the edition with verified readings from previous editions, newest first. Previously featured readings are labelled and retain their original publication date, within the 7-day limit. No article appears twice in the same edition. If fewer than 6 complete, valid readings are available even then, we preserve the last edition with its actual date.
